text:
Fix finding f3 in studies/firstmate-work-handling/findings.json so its tag matches what it says. Today its kind is could-not-run, which shows on the page as 'not run'. But most of its detail is about the paths an earlier reading missed; only the last sentence is about nothing being run. Outcome: a newcomer reading f3 sees a tag that fits all of its text. Do this either by (a) cutting f3 down to the not-run statement, naming the paths it covers in plain words and dropping the history of what an earlier reading missed, or (b) splitting it into one not-run finding and, only if a fitting kind already exists, a second finding with that kind. Do not add a new finding kind. Keep every subject id and every claim citation as it is. Acceptance: (1) the rendered page from `cargo run -p xtask -- site` shows f3 with text that matches its tag, and the source check passes; show the output; (2) a test in xtask/tests/site_page.rs asserts that the rendered f3 entry with the 'not run' tag does not contain the words 'first reading'; (3) no claim in claims.json changes; (4) CHANGELOG.md has an entry; (5) cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test pass.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Study finding f3 is tagged 'not run', but most of its text is about paths a first reading missed; three newcomer ratings have flagged the mismatch
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: studies/firstmate-work-handling/findings.json, xtask/tests/site_page.rs, claims.json, CHANGELOG.md
